evidence.any: combined with a place of worship

calculation_handling.description: A library or reading room is permitted with a place of worship if it is only accessible from inside the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Places of worship and accessory uses are not modelled.

evidence.any: combined with a place of worship

calculation_handling.description: A retail store combined with a place of worship is permitted if its interior floor area is at most 25 m2, it sells only religious goods, and it is only accessible from inside the building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Places of worship and retail use are not modelled; the religious-goods and access conditions are not modelled.

evidence.any: combined with a place of worship

calculation_handling.description: A dwelling unit combined with a place of worship is permitted if there is only one dwelling unit, its interior floor area is at most 250 m2, and the lot is in a listed zone category.
calculation_handling.gaps: The one-dwelling-unit count is not keyed as a separate limit; places of worship are not modelled; the Residential Apartment, Commercial Residential, Commercial Residential Employment and IE zones are not in the zone vocabulary.

units.disclosure: The single dwelling unit limit for a dwelling unit combined with a place of worship is not separately evaluated.

150.50.20.1(1).explanation: Combined with a place of worship you may have a library or reading room accessible only from inside. You may also have a retail store of at most 25 m2 selling only religious goods, accessible only from inside. A single dwelling unit of at most 250 m2 is allowed in the Residential, Residential Apartment, Commercial Residential and Commercial Residential Employment zone categories and the IE zone.
